localOnly.title: Privacy
localOnly.label: Local only: this project may only use models served on this machine
localOnly.onHelp: Nothing of this project is sent to an outside model service, not even as a fallback or an escalation. If no local model can answer, the work stops with a clear message instead of leaving the machine. Package downloads of the generated app are not covered.
localOnly.offHelp: Needs a model served on this machine (for example the Ollama module). Use it for confidential code.

prices.freeCalls_other: {{count}} calls went to free-tier models and are counted as free.

electricity.title: Electricity (local models)
electricity.detail: {{calls}} local calls, {{seconds}} s of generation. An estimate (watts x time x price per kWh), not a measure.
electricity.counted: Counted in the amount spent and in the budget.
electricity.apart: Shown apart: not counted in the amount spent or in the budget.

settings.title: Costs
settings.electricityHelp: Optional. When a price per kWh and the machine's power draw are set, each call to a local model records an estimated electricity cost (watts x answer time / 3.6 million x price). It is an estimate, not a measure. Unset: no electricity cost.
settings.watts: Power draw while a model generates (W)
settings.counts: Count the electricity in the amount spent and in the project budget
settings.taskHelp: A task may spend this multiple of its own estimate (at least {{floor}} USD), all its attempts together. 0 turns the cap off. A call already running when the cap is crossed still finishes, so a task can overshoot by one call. Default: {{default}}.
